title: The Final Inheritance
author: O. M. Eriksen
blurb: Kestrel Galloway, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
